description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the EnhancePortraitVideo operation in the video production (videoenhan) category
description_zh: 本文介绍视频生产（videoenhan）类目下的视频人像增强EnhancePortraitVideo的语法及示例
name: EnhancePortraitVideo

parameters.help_en: The URL of the input video. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is not in the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 输入视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoUrl.description_en:
The URL of the processed video.
This URL is a temporary URL that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible. To save the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
VideoUrl.description_zh:
处理后的视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
